Considering the cost of initial spares claimed and the value of plant & machinery (net of the cost of land), the initial spares claimed as a percentage of plant & machinery works out to 1.93% on an accrual basis and 2.16% on a cash basis, as on COD of Unit-I. Similarly, the initial spares claimed as a percentage of plant & machinery work out to 1.88% on an accrual basis and 2.05% on a cash basis, as on COD of Unit-II/ Station. In view of the above, the initial spares claimed in the Petition are well within the ceiling norm of 4% of plant & machinery cost as specified in Regulation 13 of the 2014 Tariff Regulations. Accordingly, no adjustment needs to be made, for the purpose of tariff, towards initial spares from the capital cost as allowed above as on COD of Unit-I and Unit-II. - (ii) The net normative opening loan as on COD of Unit-I is the same as the gross normative opening loan, the cumulative repayment of normative loan up to the previous year/ period being nil. - (iii) Addition to normative loan on account of additional capital expenditure allowed above has been considered. - (iv) Depreciation allowed has been considered a repayment of normative loan during the respective year of the period 2017-19.
